_comment: Documentation schema for the generic message envelope.

trace._comment: A trace event written by the engine, never sent to a capacity. It records what happened, with who it was done for. Its fields are listed below; all but ts, context_id, trace_kind and family are optional and appear only when they apply.

fields.context_id: Absolute path of the context that recorded the event.
fields.trace_kind: What happened, for example CommIngress, CommEgress, CommDrop, CommReject (communication), WrapperReady, WrpStartBuilding, WrpStartDone (execution), substance_lease_open, substance_lease_expired (matter), FamilyEnter, FamilyExit, FamilySaturated, FamilyError (the family loops).
fields.family: The engine family that produced the event: communication, execution, matter, trace or reflexive.
fields.intention_id: Correlation anchor: the id of the intention this event belongs to.
fields.msg_kind: kind of the message the event is about (intention or response).
fields.intention: The intention itself, only for CommIngress.
fields.response: The response itself, only for CommIngress.
fields.message_truncated: true when the message was too large to be kept whole in the event.
fields.message_bytes: Size in bytes of the message, when it was truncated.
fields.message_sha256: Digest of the whole message, when it was truncated.
fields.payload_keys: Names of the keys of the payload, without their values.
fields.parent_intention_id: The intention that caused this one.
fields.root_intention_id: The intention at the start of the chain.
fields.principal: Who the work is done for: the principal that was admitted for the root of the request. Stamped by the engine from the admission, never taken from a message.
fields.actor: The actor the principal declared for the root of the request, when it has actors. Stamped by the engine.
fields.reason_code: Why a message was dropped or refused (CommDrop, CommReject), a stable reason such as context_unreachable or context_stopped.
fields.user_text: A short human-readable text with the details of the event.

fields._routing_comment: Depending on kind, only one payload among intention, response, or trace is expected.
